sahneler.metin: A freighter slammed into a support pier of Florida's Sunshine Skyway.
A main span fell into Tampa Bay, and thirty five people were killed.
A sudden squall had blinded the ship's pilot.
The freighter drifted out of the channel.
The piers had no protection against a ship.
In the rain, drivers couldn't see the missing span.
Several vehicles drove straight off the edge.
The new bridge sits behind huge concrete islands that stop ships.

aciklama:
Sunshine Skyway lost a main span when a freighter hit it. The cause: ship impact on an unprotected support pier.
